277402967.description:
RocksAndMinerals.com Sedimentary Rock Collection Set 15 Specimens #3131-000
Boxed sedimentary rock collection set from rocksandminerals.com, stock #3131-000. Contains 15 numbered rock specimens in a white compartmentalized tray with a brown lid. Features clastic, chemical, and organic sedimentary rocks including conglomerate, sandstone, limestone, shale, and bituminous coal. Includes two detailed identification and explanation cards describing properties and origins of each rock type. Specimens show natural textures and colors. Suitable for educational use, collectors, or geology enthusiasts.
11 x 7 x 1.5 in
